scripts.build: pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/contracts build && pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/client-core build && pnpm -r --filter api --filter web build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/contracts build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter api --filter web dev
scripts.dev:mobile: pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/contracts build && pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/client-core build && pnpm --filter mobile start
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/contracts build && pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/client-core build && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 test:all
scripts.lint: oxlint backend/src frontend/src packages/contracts/src packages/client-core/src mobile/src
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/contracts build && pnpm --filter @gomecoiffer/client-core build && pnpm -r typecheck
